gloss: to get excited; to be agitated; to be aroused

definitions.gloss: to get excited; to be thrilled
definitions.explanation: To become emotionally stimulated or worked up, often with enthusiasm or anticipation.

definitions.gloss: to be agitated; to be upset
definitions.explanation: To become emotionally overwrought, angry, or worked up in a negative sense.

examples.english: I got excited about the game.
The children were excited the day before the field trip.

notes:
Describes a state of heightened emotional arousal. Can be positive (excitement, thrill) or negative (agitation, being worked up). The noun form ⟦{興奮|こうふん}→興奮：02751_koufun⟧ is also very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{興奮|こうふん}→興奮：02751_koufun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{冷|さ}める→冷める：02114_sameru⟧: the excitement dies down
- ⟦{興奮|こうふん}→興奮：02751_koufun⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: state of excitement
- ⟦{興奮|こうふん}{気味|ぎみ}→興奮気味：22574_koufungimi⟧: somewhat excited
- ⟦{興奮|こうふん}→興奮：02751_koufun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧: to suppress one's excitement
- {大|おお}⟦{興奮|こうふん}→興奮：02751_koufun⟧: great excitement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ワクワクする→ワクワクする：25801_wakuwakusuru⟧: to be thrilled — implies pleasant anticipation, always positive
- ⟦ドキドキする→ドキドキする：21628_dokidokisuru⟧: heart pounding — implies nervousness or excitement, often romantic
- {昂|たかぶ}る: to be worked up — literary, emphasizes rising emotions
